edge_source: SPRINT-39 §2.1 Phase Plan + §2.2 Merge Ordering (all 18 digests returned dep_predecessors: [] — Bug/CR/Story templates carry no such frontmatter field; clause 5 would see zero edges without this override)
milestone_barrier: Waves never cross a milestone boundary. Milestones execute as ordered blocks M0 -> M1 -> M2 -> M3 -> M4 with a barrier between them: every wave of milestone N completes and merges before the first wave of milestone N+1 is cut. §2.1 permits M1/M3/M4 to run concurrently with M0, but a linear wave list cannot express cross-milestone concurrency without a cross-milestone wave, so the milestones are serialized. This is the safe direction (over-serialization) and it satisfies every cross-milestone edge in §2.2: STORY-054-03 -> CR-105 (CLAUDE.md, M1->M3), STORY-054-03 -> STORY-054-06 (story.md, M1->M2), STORY-054-02 -> CR-108 (work-item-type.ts, M1->M4), STORY-054-06 -> CR-108 (templates/*.md, M2->M4).

lane_audit_note: §2.4 declares no fast-lane items: all 18 touch gated or mirrored surfaces. Every story is a two-tree dogfood edit (live + cleargate-planning/ canonical), which alone disqualifies fast lane.
surface_caveats: collision_surface.sh was fixed mid-kickoff (BUG-049) to parse Bug/CR Execution Sandbox prose and over-reports tokens from trailing '— description' text. Artefact tokens treated as exact strings only, never expanded: 'mcp/', 'cleargate-planning/' (bare), 'cleargate-cli/test/', '*.node.test.ts', 'state.json', 'Sprint Plan Template.md', 'cleargate-planning/.cleargate/templates/*', '.cleargate/templates/{Bug,CR,epic,initiative,story,hotfix}.md'.

Bare-directory and glob tokens are matched by exact string per the existing predicate and are NOT expanded into collisions with specific files beneath them. Expanding 'cleargate-planning/' (BUG-046, CR-108, CR-111) or 'cleargate-cli/test/' (BUG-042, BUG-043, CR-105, BUG-045) would have collapsed wave10 and wave12 into fully serial chains with no real conflict behind them.

CR-105's file_creates carries '*.node.test.ts' and 'cleargate-cli/test/' — glob/bare-dir artefacts, not literal created files. CR-105 is serialized behind BUG-043 on a genuine clause-2 hit (inject-claude-md.ts, upgrade.ts) regardless.
No digest had an empty (file_surface ∪ file_creates); the BUG-033 empty-surface guard did not fire for any story.
No digest had a non-empty db_write_set; the coarse DB collision axis did not serialize anything this sprint.
